== Overview ==

In TibiaOrigins, every level rewards you with Attribute Points to invest in unique stats, letting you build characters beyond vocation limits. Extra attribute points can be obtained finishing quests, gaining skills, making runes, etc! This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
